name: BT Catalog
changelog: New: Refresh just this brand. Re-pulls one label's styles in a minute or two instead of running the whole catalog for ~40, using the same paced batching as the nightly refresh — no list to paste. Fixes: pasting a long list into Step B fired two API calls per style with no pause until S&S answered 503, and every remaining style was then recorded as a per-style failure, so a rate limit looked like a list of bad style numbers; the import now paces itself, stops cleanly when S&S pushes back, says so, and puts whatever is left back in the box ready to resubmit. Step B also split on every space, so the brand + number form it asks for ('Shaka SHCLT') was torn into two tokens and could never resolve — it now splits on lines and commas only.
